why: Don't block. Kird Ape (1/1) into Grizzly Bears (9/9) is a poor trade—loses the creature and only saves 8 damage. I'm at high life (20), so preserving the Kird Ape for future utility (or for next turn once it loses summoning sickness if the engine is tracking it) is better than chump-blocking. Take 9 damage and stay alive to cast Bonebreaker Giant next turn.
